detectors.requiredObservations: An Express factory-bound route callback directly calls an included local exported function.
detectors.observation: An Express route callback calls a statically resolved local function boundary.
detectors.limitation: Does not establish API stability, complete routing or separation of all responsibilities.

detectors.requiredObservations: The first effect in a route callback parses request input with a local Zod object schema; a later local call consumes that parsed binding.
detectors.observation: A route parses request input with a Zod object schema before passing the parsed value to a local function.
detectors.limitation: Only a straight-line parse path is supported; schema completeness, error middleware and other routes are unknown.

detectors.requiredObservations: A leading missing-user guard returns a 401 JSON response before a local call consumes that request user.

detectors.limitation: This is an authentication-state guard, not proof of credential verification or resource authorization.
